tours.name: Review a User's Access Rights
tours.description: Learn how to see which groups a user belongs to and so which apps and actions that person is allowed to use.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to see which groups a user belongs to and so which apps and actions that person is allowed to use.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.description: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

description_i18n.en_US: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

steps.title: Users & Companies
steps.description: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

description_i18n.en_US: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

steps.title: Users
steps.description: Every person who can sign in to Odoo is listed here. Open a user to see or change what that person is allowed to do.

description_i18n.en_US: Every person who can sign in to Odoo is listed here. Open a user to see or change what that person is allowed to do.

steps.title: Open a user
steps.content: Click any user to open the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click any user to open the record.

steps.description: The form shows how many groups, access rights and record rules the user ends up with.

description_i18n.en_US: The form shows how many groups, access rights and record rules the user ends up with.

steps.title: Access rights tab
steps.content: Look at the Access Rights tab. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the Access Rights tab. Click it to continue.

steps.description: This tab lists every group of the user. The apps the user sees in the menu come from these groups.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab lists every group of the user. The apps the user sees in the menu come from these groups.

steps.title: Groups count
steps.content: Click Groups to open the full list of groups.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Groups to open the full list of groups.

steps.description: The number is the groups the user belongs to, including the ones inherited from higher groups.

description_i18n.en_US: The number is the groups the user belongs to, including the ones inherited from higher groups.

steps.title: Groups list
steps.content: These are all the groups. Click the column headings to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: These are all the groups. Click the column headings to finish.

steps.description: Use this list to check why a user can or cannot open an app.

description_i18n.en_US: Use this list to check why a user can or cannot open an app.
